heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: In addition to any funds authorized to be appropriated to the Commission under section 20930 of this title, there are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this subchapter—

tree.text: such sums as may be necessary for each succeeding fiscal year.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 15523 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
